ordersText.title: PSYKER LEGION
ordersText.general: While resolving this, order you can spend a forge token when purchasing an upgrade of any type to temporarily reduce the upgrade's command level restriction by 1. You can do this for every upgrade you purchase, but you cannot spend more than 1 token per an upgrade.

ordersText.title: RUBRIC OF AHRIMAN
ordersText.general: After you resolve this order, you may spend 1 forge token to place 1 free Rubric Marine on a friendly world containing a Cairic Acolyte in the active system. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: TELEPATHY
ordersText.general: During the first round of a combat initiated by this order, you may look at your opponent's facedown Combat card before choosing and playing yours. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: FIRES OF CHANGE
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. *newline*  During this orbital strike, before assigning damage, you may spend 1 [M] to force you opponent to choose a CL1, CL2 or CL3 unit on the target world and replace it with a CL0 unit. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: PRECOGNITION
ordersText.general: When you resolve this order, look at the second-top card of your event deck. You may move it to the bottom of your deck.

eventsText.title: UNEXPECTED TRICK
eventsText.general: Resolve an advance order in any system. You cannot move ground units or initiate combat during this advance, but you can initiate an orbital strike. If you do, gain 1 [D] during this orbital strike.

eventsText.title: FORBIDDEN SORCERY
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card at the end of the next Event Phase. *newpara* While this card is in play, your command level is increased by 1.

eventsText.title: WARP REALITY
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this scheme any time your opponent plays a combat card during a combat. He cannot resolve any of the card's abilities.

eventsText.title: THE GREAT PLAN
eventsText.general: Remove 1 of your order tokens from the game. If you do, all other players must place a matching token on top of their event decks after the end of the current Event phase. They will place 1 fewer order token during the next Planning phase.

eventsText.title: PRODIGAL SONS
eventsText.general: Choose a neutral void in a system containing no friendly areas. Either place 1 free Hellfire Cruiser in that void, or spend 1 materiel to place 2 free Hellfire Cruisers in that void, or spend 2 materiel and 1 forge token to place 1 free Relic Battlebarge in that void.

eventsText.title: KNWOLEDGE IS TREASURE
eventsText.general: Gain 1 materiel for every friendly void. If you gained 2 or less materiel, draw and resolve an additional event card (but do not move warp storms again).

eventsText.title: UNWIND TIME
eventsText.general: After all warp storms have been moved, players must immediately move warp storms again, starting with you and going in a clockwise order. All other players must draw 1 event card and move a warp storm according to that card, but you keep this card instead.

eventsText.title: MASTERY OF THE WARP
eventsText.general: Rotate 2 system tiles around a shared warp storm boundary. *newline* Maintain all units, structures, tokens, and any other assets as well as the orientation of those tiles relative to each other. *newpara* *newpara*

combatText.title: ELDRICH SMITE
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. You may spend it to either gain 1 (B) or to force your opponent to lose a matching [D].
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose a matching [D].

combatText.title: PROTECTION OF THE WARP
combatText.general: Gain 1 [D]. If you gained [B], gain 1 (S). *newpara* If you have more [M] than your opponent, gain 1 (S).
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Either rally 1 unit or convert 1 of your [D] to [M].

combatText.title: EMBRACE MADNESS
combatText.general: Convert 1 of your opponent's [D] to [B], [S] or [M]. *newline* Convert 1 of your opponent's [D] to [B], [S] or [M] for every unrouted Cairic Acolyte, Lord of Change or Hellfire Cruiser.
combatText.unit: Acolyte/Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Gain 1 (S) for each of your opponent's [M].

combatText.title: WARD OF CHANGE
combatText.general: You must simultaneously convert all of your [B] to [S], all of your [S] to [M] and all of your [M] to [B].

combatText.title: FICKLE SORCERY
combatText.unit: Acolyte: Reroll 1 [D]. If [M] was rolled, gain 1 [D].

combatText.title: INFERNAL FLAMES
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Mutalith/Lord of Change: Spend any number of [M] to destroy 1 enemy CL0 unit and gain 1 (B) for every [M] spent.

combatText.title: PINK HORRORS
combatText.general: Your opponent gains 1 [D] and you gain 2 [D].
combatText.unit: Acolyte/Cruiser: Gain 1 (B) for each [S] rolled while resolving the general ability of this card.

combatText.title: BLUE HORRORS
combatText.general: Resolve the general ability of a basic combat card from your upgrade deck.
combatText.unit: Rubric Marine/Cruiser: Force your opponent to lose 1 [M]. If he did, gain 1 (S).

combatText.title: MEDDLING OF TZEENTCH
combatText.general: During this combat, the last card played by your opponent (at any particular moment) provides no combat icons.
combatText.unit: Acolyte/Lord of Change: Discard one of your opponent's combat cards in play.

combatText.title: PSYCHIC TEMPEST
combatText.general: If you have at least 1 [M], your opponent chooses and replaces 1 of his CL1, CL2 or CL3 units on this world with a unit of a lower CL from his supply, if able.
combatText.unit: Mutalith/Cruiser/Relic Battlebarge: Gain 1 (B) for every [B] you have.

combatText.title: UNCONTROLABLE MUTATIONS
combatText.general: Destroy a friendly unit to place a free reinforcement token in this area for every forge token on your faction mat.
combatText.unit: Mutalith/Relic Battlebarge: Gain 1 [D] for every forge token on your faction mat.

combatText.title: ALTER THE PAST
combatText.general: Play a basic or a CL0 combat card from your upgrade deck. Do not resolve its abilities but gain its icons during this combat.
combatText.unit: Acolyte/Lord of Change: Resolve the general abilities of the played card. Then resolve the unit abilities, if you satisfy the requirements.

combatText.title: CHANGER OF WAYS
combatText.unit: Lord of Change/Relic Battlebarge: Return 1 of your combat cards in play to your hand and replace it with a card from your upgrade deck. Do not resolve the abilities of the newly played card, but gain its icons for this combat.

combatText.title: MAGNUS'S PENANCE
combatText.unit: Acolyte/Lord of Change/Cruiser: Resolve the abilities of all your combat cards in play, starting from the earliest one. Then discard this card and play the top card from your deck. Do not resolve its abilities but gain its icons during this combat.
